generalComment.value: This EPD is based on the life cycle assessment of the Jumpax® Nature flooring system from Unifloor B.V. . The declaration holder is liable for the underlying information and evidence. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts is not liable for manufacturer information, life cycle assessment data and evidence.

description.value: For data protection reasons, the assumptions made and data used are only explained in the background report accompanying this EPD. For the transport to the construction site in module A4, a scenario with a distance of 286 km and the environmental profile "market group for transport, freight, lorry, unspecified {GLO}" from Ecoinvent 3.6 was used. No auxiliary or operating materials or energy were taken into account when installing the product in module A5, as only human muscle power is required for the installation. There are no direct emissions into the ambient air, soil or water. But there is packaging waste in the form of protective film, which is removed from the adhesive surfaces, and a Euro pallet, which was used for transport. As a conservative approach, an additional 3 % installation waste was assumed. For disposal, a waste scenario for "MDF" based on the NMD waste scenario ID 36 from the Netherlands was adapted and used for Germany. Here, 5 % landfilling and 95 % incineration were assumed. For the distance to waste treatment, 100 km for landfilling and 150 km for incineration were used with "market group for transport, freight, lorry, unspecified {GLO}" (from Ecoinvent 3.6). The energy saving (credit) from incineration was adjusted for the German market. For the landfill loads, "99% Waste wood, untreated and 1% Waste paint {EU}| treatment of, sanitary landfill" was used and for the incineration "Waste building wood, chrome preserved {CH}| treatment of, municipal incineration".

timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: All product- and process-specific data were collected for the operating year 2021 and are thus up-to date.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: Jumpax® Nature is the unique combination of the best sustainable FSC-certified materials and an extremely resilient load distribution layer. In the past, the use of natural materials always resulted in a limitation of use. With a system height of only 14.5 mm and a load capacity of 4 kN point load, Jumpax® Nature is the highest-performing dry screed made of sustainable materials with best impact sound reduction values of min 20 dB. The mass-containing wood fibres support the impact sound insulation in a natural way. The subfloor system consists of FSC-certified MDF boards and wood fibres, the contact adhesive does not contain any questionable solvents. Manufactured in protected workshops in the Netherlands and Germany.
